# Write Session Variable.vi

![Write Session Variable.vi function icon](../../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/WS-APP-SES-07.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../../../index.md) · [All functions](../../../../index.md)

Creates or replaces typed session variables and returns their previous string values.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

## IN — inputs

| Displayed terminal / internal ID | Accepted / resolved type | Studio connection | Unwired input default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LabVIEW Web Service Request `labview_web_service_request` | `ref<connectivity.web_service_request>` | Required | Not specified | Identifies the HTTP request processed by this VI. |
| key `key` | `string` | Required | Not specified | Name of the HTTP session variable to read, replace or delete. |
| value `value` | `string` | Required | Not specified | Typed value or corresponding array of values assigned to the selected variables. |
| error in `error_in` | `cluster<status:bool,code:i32,source:string>` | Recommended | `{status:false,code:0,source:""}` | Carries error information from earlier diagram operations. |

A default is shown only for an input with an explicitly documented value. Preview/default *types* do not imply unwired operand values. If helper and binding flags differ, both are labelled.

## OUT — outputs

| Displayed terminal / internal ID | Accepted / resolved type | Studio connection | Unwired input default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LabVIEW Web Service Request out `labview_web_service_request_out` | `ref<connectivity.web_service_request>` | Recommended | — | Preserves the request identity for subsequent Web Services VIs. |
| previous value `previous_value` | `string` | Recommended | — | Previous session value returned as a string, including for numeric or Boolean writes. |
| replaced? `replaced` | `bool` | Recommended | — | Indicates that an existing session variable was overwritten. |
| error out `error_out` | `cluster<status:bool,code:i32,source:string>` | Recommended | — | Returns error status, numeric code and source text. |
